title: Column marginal of a product distribution
statement: Let $p$ be a mixed strategy over $M$ actions for the row player and $q$ a mixed strategy over $N$ actions for the column player, and let $\sigma$ be their product distribution, which assigns probability $p_i\,q_j$ to each pure profile $(i,j)$. Then for every column action $j$, the column marginal of $\sigma$ at $j$ equals $q_j$; that is, $\sum_{i} p_i\,q_j = q_j$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a mixed strategy over M actions
q is a mixed strategy over N actions
sigma is the product distribution of p and q
replaced:
For the product distribution of $p$ and $q$, the column marginal at $j$ equals
$q_j$ (the original column mixed-strategy weight).
